locatedFindings.finding: Retyping produces incomplete prefixes; opacity leaves suffixes, quantities or qualifiers at low contrast. Do not count these active states as a complete reading hold.

locatedFindings.finding: A shaped-cluster prefix can stop at the Thai leading vowel เ before เมื่อ. Grapheme/run identity does not promise a complete word. locatedFindings.finding: The enlarged mixed Latin suffix can wrap inside USB-C at zero tracking. Opt-in optical tracking moves 499 onto the first promotional line while บาท stays on the second. Characters remain present; semantic token or number/unit keep-together is not guaranteed.
Noto alias boundaries use identical Thai font bytes. Plex mixed controls style X2 only. These samples do not qualify a distinct Thai face or arbitrary cross-face boundary.

productionDisposition.intactMotion: Keep complete required copy together through existing intact full-selection/all-text-anchor/no-stagger routes, with font coverage and actual final layout/reading holds checked for each production copy. The sampled matrix does not grant general pack or production acceptance.
productionDisposition.finerThaiMotion: Not adopted for required complete words, prices, units or qualifications on the basis of this packet. Translation/rotation samples retain marks but every-intermediate-frame shaping, overlap and gap guarantees remain unqualified.
productionDisposition.retypingAndOpacity: Active transitions are not certified complete reading holds. Provide a verified intact resolved hold if these optional transitions are used.
productionDisposition.tracking: Opt-in only; zero/default compatibility remains preserved. Inspect final wraps, protected tokens and number/unit grouping before adopting optical tracking for a production text.
productionDisposition.repairs: No typography source/default repair is introduced by this review. These are located constraints and evidence for future explicitly scoped changes.

retainedAuditAttempts.cause: Compared formatted JSON raw bytes with preflight compact JSON hashes. No artifact mutation. Corrected to compare raw hashes with prior render-run file receipts; both conventions explicitly named.

verification.softwareInputs: Held by the owning full51 gate; review evidence documentation is excluded from that inventory.
verification.fullSoftwareGate: Separate live attempt full51-1; this record does not assert its result.

limits: Only frames8 and18 were reviewed for all distinct cells in this expansion. Prior seventeen artifacts include selected consecutive sequences but do not close every active cell/frame.
Native overviews are cropped/resized contact images; full1920x1080 originals and all consecutive active frames2-19 remain retained for deeper review.
320/360 reductions are LANCZOS bitmap proxies, not an actual phone, compression ladder or human reading/listening acceptance.
No new rendering, paid generation, owner acceptance, supported pack or accepted pilot episode is claimed.
